title: Warrior Expansion Mod
description: It adds new fighting mobs to the game
body:
In this modification you have new new types of the warriors for the **"WARRIORS"** mod which can fight for and with you!

You also have a lot of new fighters like **THE ARCHER** who shoots with arrows, **THE GUARDIAN** who is very strong, **THE TANK** who barely moves but has lots of health and **THE KNIGHT** who is pretty well at fighting! Fight with your new friends and let them fight for you!

It's just an addition for the **WARRIORS** mod. I hope you'll enjoy playing and fighting with your new friends in this mod!
